name: dragon
goal: You are in the End with a bow, arrows, a diamond sword, armour, blocks and food. Kill the ender dragon: first shoot the end crystals on top of the obsidian pillars (shoot(entity) with the bow, or pillar up with blocks and break them by hand; stay away from the ones with iron bars until last), then wait near the bedrock fountain in the middle; when the dragon perches there, hit it with the sword, and shoot it with the bow while it flies. Never dig down here: below the island is the void. Say 'dragon dead' when it dies.
